title: CFPB Complaint Spike Signals
description: Find statistically meaningful complaint-volume spikes by company and product in the CFPB Consumer Complaint Database.

currentDays.title: Current window (days)
currentDays.description: Number of most recent days to treat as the current comparison window.

baselineDays.title: Baseline window (days)
baselineDays.description: Number of preceding days used to estimate each company/product baseline complaint rate.

minCurrentComplaints.title: Minimum current complaints
minCurrentComplaints.description: Minimum complaint count in the current window required before a spike can qualify.

minSpikeRatio.title: Minimum spike ratio
minSpikeRatio.description: Minimum ratio of current complaints to the baseline-expected complaint count.

maxSignals.title: Maximum signals
maxSignals.description: Maximum number of ranked complaint-spike signals to return in one run.
